sentences.text: American Horror Story is an American anthology horror television series created and produced by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk .	Horror	Horror (genre)	Ryan Murphy	Ryan Murphy (writer)	Brad Falchuk	Brad Falchuk	anthology	Anthology series	horror	Horror fiction

Described as an anthology series , each season is conceived as a self-contained miniseries , following a disparate set of characters and settings , and a storyline with its own `` beginning , middle , and end . ''	anthology	Anthology series	miniseries	miniseries
Some plot elements of each season are loosely inspired by true events .

The first season , retroactively subtitled Murder House , takes place in Los Angeles , California , during the year 2011 and centers on a family that moves into a house haunted by its deceased former occupants .	Murder House	American Horror Story: Murder House	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	California	California

The second season , subtitled Asylum , takes place in Massachusetts during the year 1964 and follows the stories of the patients and staff of an institution for the criminally insane .	Asylum	American Horror Story: Asylum	Massachusetts	Massachusetts

The third season , subtitled Coven , takes place in New Orleans , Louisiana , during the year 2013 and follows a coven of witches who face off against those who wish to destroy them .	Coven	American Horror Story: Coven

The fourth season , subtitled Freak Show , takes place in Jupiter , Florida , during the year 1952 and centers around one of the few remaining American freak shows .	Freak Show	American Horror Story: Freak Show	freak shows	freak shows

The fifth season , subtitled Hotel , takes place in Los Angeles during the year 2015 and focuses on the staff and guests of a supernatural hotel .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	Hotel	American Horror Story: Hotel

The sixth season , subtitled Roanoke , takes place in Roanoke Island , during the year 2016 and focuses on the paranormal events that take place at an isolated farmhouse .	Roanoke	American Horror Story: Roanoke	Roanoke Island	Roanoke Island
The only actors to appear in all iterations of the show so far are Evan Peters , Sarah Paulson and Lily Rabe .	Evan Peters	Evan Peters	Sarah Paulson	Sarah Paulson	Lily Rabe	Lily Rabe
The series is broadcast on the cable television channel FX in the United States .	FX	FX (TV channel)
On November 10 , 2015 , the show was renewed for a sixth season , and premiered , for the first time out of October , on September 14 , 2016 .
On October 4 , 2016 , the series was renewed for a seventh season , which is set to premiere in September 2017 .
On January 12 , 2017 , the series was renewed for an eighth and ninth season .

Although reception to individual seasons has varied , American Horror Story has been overall well received by television critics , with the majority of the praise going to the cast , particularly Jessica Lange , who won two Emmy Awards , a Golden Globe Award , and a Screen Actors Guild Award for her performances .	Horror	Horror (genre)	Jessica Lange	Jessica Lange	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award	Screen Actors Guild Award	Screen Actors Guild Award

Additionally , Kathy Bates and Lady Gaga won an Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award , respectively , for their performances .	Kathy Bates	Kathy Bates	Lady Gaga	Lady Gaga	Emmy Award	Emmy Award	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award
The series draws consistently high ratings for the FX network , with its first season being the most-viewed new cable series of 2011 .	FX	FX (TV channel)
